top.title: Vertex Posts Positive Phase II Data on Kidney Disease Drug
top.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals reported positive results from its phase IIb AMPLIFIED study, showing that inaxaplin reduced UACR by 42.7% in AMKD patients with modest proteinuria and 17.3% in those with AMKD and type II diabetes. The company has completed enrollment in the phase II/III AMPLITUDE pivotal study, with interim data expected in early 2027. Inaxaplin was well-tolerated with no serious adverse events reported.

top.title: FDA Accepts Insmed's Filing Seeking Label Expansion for Arikayce
top.summary: Insmed announced FDA acceptance of a regulatory filing for Arikayce label expansion to treat newly diagnosed MAC lung disease patients. The FDA granted priority review with a decision expected by January 28, 2027. Arikayce sales grew 7% to $214.4 million in H1 2026, with full-year expectations of $450-470 million. The label expansion could significantly increase the addressable market from 30,000 to over 200,000 patients.

top.summary: General Mills beat Q1 earnings estimates with adjusted EPS of 75 cents, though both net sales and EPS declined year-over-year. top.title: Coty Americas LFL Sales Rise 6%: What Is Driving Regional Strength?

However, full-year fiscal 2026 Americas revenues declined 1% on a reported basis.
